name: Expiry Notification
script:
def get_status(expiry_date):
    if not expiry_date:
        return ""

    days_left = frappe.utils.date_diff(
        frappe.utils.getdate(expiry_date),
        frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
    )

    if days_left > 60:
        return "Valid"
    elif days_left > 30:
        return "Expiring Soon"
    elif days_left >= 0:
        return "Expiring"
    else:
        return "Expired"

# update ALL Documents child rows for Staff
rows = frappe.get_all(
    "Documents",
    filters={"parenttype": "Staff"},
    fields=["name", "expiry_date", "status"]
)

changed = 0
for r in rows:
    new_status = get_status(r.expiry_date)
    if (r.status or "") != (new_status or ""):
        frappe.db.set_value("Documents", r.name, "status", new_status, update_modified=False)
        changed += 1

frappe.db.commit()
